description: Calculates the B-20 qualifying rate, the qualifying payment, and the resulting GDS/TDS from a principal, contract rate, amortization, and income. It computes the payment itself, so it needs those loan terms. Results are neutral scenario math, not an approval or underwriting decision. Works only from explicit, non-identifying numbers in the request. Returns calculations only: no approval, underwriting, or suitability decisions, no lender or product recommendations, and no values looked up from chats, files, accounts, documents, or the web.

bufferRate.description: Optional stress-test buffer added to the contract rate. Omit it to use the disclosed default. Supply the annual rate as a decimal; for example, 5.25% is 0.0525.

contractRate.description: Contract rate for the mortgage. Supply the annual rate as a decimal; for example, 5.25% is 0.0525.

effectiveDate.description: Date the supplied rates and policy assumptions were confirmed.

floorRate.description: Optional minimum qualification rate. Omit it to use the disclosed default. Supply the annual rate as a decimal; for example, 5.25% is 0.0525.

grossAnnualIncome.description: Gross annual household income in Canadian dollars.

monthlyCondoFees.description: Monthly condominium fees in Canadian dollars.

monthlyHeat.description: Monthly heating cost in Canadian dollars.

monthlyPropertyTax.description: Monthly property-tax amount in Canadian dollars.

otherMonthlyDebts.description: Total monthly debt obligations outside the housing costs in Canadian dollars.

gdsMax.description: Maximum GDS ratio as a decimal; for example, 39% is 0.39.

tdsMax.description: Maximum TDS ratio as a decimal; for example, 44% is 0.44.

name: calculate_qualification
title: Calculate B-20 Stress-Test Qualification
